profile.name: Dr. Zamir Ahmad Wani
profile.intro: Antennas, engineered electromagnetic materials, and RF systems for wireless communication, sensing, and imaging.

about.text:
I am an Assistant Professor in the Department of Electronics & Instrumentation Technology at the University of Kashmir. My work brings together antenna engineering, electromagnetics, and RF and microwave systems.

I received my Ph.D. from IIT Delhi and my M.Tech. from IIITDM Jabalpur. My research interests include millimeter-wave and MIMO antennas, metamaterials, metasurfaces, and RF circuits, with applications in wireless communication and microwave imaging.
